title: Workspace Lambda GitHub Tooling Optimization v1
goal: Generalize and optimize the reusable workspace-control tooling that connects ChatGPT/GitHub workflows to project-isolated Lambda self-hosted execution, reducing human-terminal mediation and repeated project-specific glue while preserving the accepted security, provenance, exact-SHA, cleanup, and rollback boundaries proven by the current research-engine pilot.
acceptance_criteria: The task begins from the exact accepted/self-hosted-runner pilot evidence rather than redesigning the Lambda runner architecture from scratch.
The active P3/P4/P5 acceptance lineage owned by workspace-lambda-self-hosted-execution-v1 remains authoritative and is not silently rewritten by optimization work.
Repeated repository-specific launcher, JIT-runner, receipt, cleanup, and GitHub-follow-up logic is inventoried and separated into reusable workspace-control components where justified by evidence.

A reusable project/profile contract can express trusted workflow identity, exact candidate SHA, CPU/GPU/resource policy, permitted host dependencies, artifact/receipt requirements, timeout/cleanup behavior, and denied production surfaces.

ChatGPT can drive the normal loop branch/PR -> trusted default-branch workflow -> Lambda JIT runner -> artifacts/checks -> evidence consumption -> bounded repair/retry without routine SSH after the pilot is accepted.
Terminal GitHub results are consumed immediately; polling/waiting is used only while compute is actually active or a human-only credential/privilege gate remains.
CPU-only and GPU-aware validation lanes share one control-plane abstraction without weakening device, process, network, cache, or project isolation.
Host dependency bootstrap/preflight steps such as exact pgvector provisioning are declarative, bounded, idempotent, receipt-producing, and separated from candidate code execution.
Runner credentials remain short-lived/repository-scoped; no persistent personal Git/SSH/browser credentials or normal atrott-user authority are introduced.
One-job ephemeral/JIT semantics, exact candidate checkout, full cleanup, leaked-process detection, and artifact return remain fail-closed invariants.
Existing GitHub-hosted CI remains a known-good control and is not removed merely because the Lambda lane becomes faster or more capable.

Optimization produces measurable improvements in operator/tool-call latency, duplicated code, number of human terminal steps, runner spin-up/teardown overhead, and failure diagnosis quality before broader adoption.
At least one second repository/profile can be represented by the generalized contract without giving it access to research-engine-specific state, demonstrating project isolation.
All reusable changes live in workspace-control; research-engine-specific scientific/production truth remains in research-engine and its owning tasks.
constraints: Heartbeat v0.4.0 remains the current side-project closure item; do not start broad Lambda tooling mutation merely because this child capsule exists unless the user explicitly transfers ownership.
Do not mutate the active workspace-lambda-self-hosted-execution-v1 P3/P4/P5 acceptance state from this child task; rehydrate it first and inherit terminal evidence.
Do not replace the existing Runner Scale Set Client / JIT / project-UID architecture without new evidence that the accepted topology is insufficient.
Do not weaken one-job runner destruction, no-sudo, no-Docker-socket, no-personal-credential, production-state denial, or exact-SHA execution boundaries for convenience.
Do not generalize research-engine-specific pgvector/PostgreSQL requirements into mandatory global behavior; model them as project/profile dependencies.
Do not introduce a persistent privileged runner service until the parent task explicitly accepts that stage.
Do not use the Lambda lane for untrusted forks or arbitrary pull_request code with secrets/write credentials.
Do not manufacture GPU/model workloads solely to benchmark orchestration; use naturally authorized validation work where possible.
Prefer batchable/durable GitHub evidence and compact receipts over giant logs or opaque long-running waits.
Treat the existing human SSH path as break-glass recovery, not the desired routine control plane.
